_about: Settings for models/tools/prep_game_model.py (models from driving games, which come with several overlapping versions of each part and no wheels). Object names come from the downloaded file; regexes match the start of a name.
_delete: Near the end: the extra exhaust tip designs (the single round tips stay), the rally mud flaps behind the wheels, and the boot lettering (back to front in the file, several overlapping model names, plus an xDrive badge the rear-wheel-drive 440i doesn't have). models/bmw440i.json adds clean badges instead.
_paint: The bonnet is the smooth carbon-version panel (.002); the black one is lumpy and is deleted above.
_colours: Material name prefix: [red, green, blue, roughness] (linear 0-1). The game tints these at run time. ARm4_mechanicals_d and etkc are the wheel-arch linings, suspension and underbody (plain white in the file, so they showed as white slivers at the arches).
_cabin: Left-hand-drive model: these interior parts are mirrored so the steering wheel is on the right (UK).
